# TikTok Video Downloader HD — full reference

Canonical URL: https://tiktokvideodownloaderhd.vercel.app/
Last updated: 2026-11-25
Language: English

This file gives AI assistants and search systems a compact, factual description of the tool. For human-readable walkthroughs, use the guide links at the end.

## Product summary

TikTok Video Downloader HD is a free, browser-based utility for saving public TikTok media. It requires no account and no browser extension. Optional Android APK, Windows .exe (portable or installer) and iPhone Home Screen (PWA) wrappers are available for users who want an app-like icon; none is required to use the tool. It works on desktop and mobile browsers including Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge. The homepage FAQ answers 30 questions about downloads, quality, audio, compatibility, privacy, copyright, and troubleshooting.

The tool supports three output modes:

1. MP4 — the clean video stream with the best available audio, at exactly the resolutions the source offers. Estimated file sizes are shown before saving.
2. MP3 — the audio track extracted and encoded at 192 kbps.
3. Story — an active TikTok story or a direct story media link, saved as MP4.

Direct `.mp4`, `.webm`, and `.ogg` URLs can also be saved through the browser. A prepared video can be previewed before the final save.

## User workflow

1. The visitor copies a public TikTok link using TikTok's Share → Copy link action.
2. The link is pasted into the tool on the home page and Download is clicked.
3. Metadata (thumbnail, title, duration) and available formats appear almost instantly.
4. The visitor chooses MP4, MP3, or Story and a specific variant.
5. The file is prepared in a background request while a short ad is displayed.
6. Closing the ad starts the browser download immediately to the default Downloads folder.

Large files (100 MB+) and long videos (10–20 minutes) use the same background preparation path, so closing the ad does not add extra waiting time.

## Technical behavior

- TikTok links are resolved server-side with yt-dlp through small Vercel Python functions, then streamed back to the browser.
- Direct video links are fetched client-side into a Blob.
- Downloaded files are not retained after the request ends.
- The clean media stream is used, so the TikTok watermark overlay is not burned into MP4 files.
- Private, deleted, age-restricted, and login-only content is not supported.
- Stories are normally available for 24 hours; expired stories cannot be recovered from public links.
- Story mode may be blocked on some networks; a direct story media link is the reliable fallback.
- The site shows ads to stay free. Ads appear when a format is selected; the file is already being prepared when the ad opens.
- A web app manifest and minimal service worker make the site installable on Android and iPhone Home Screens. API responses and APK downloads are never cached; the service worker only caches the static app shell and guide pages for offline reading.

## Ownership and permissions

Only public links can be read. Users should save only content they own or have clear permission to reuse. The tool is not affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance.
